This subdomain's own llms.txt (docs/seo.md, "AEO / AI search").

The independence relationship is stated first and plainly. An answer engine
summarising this site without it would describe these practitioners as Kiam
clinicians — which is the single misrepresentation the whole project is built to
avoid. Everything else here is secondary to that sentence.

{% endcomment %}# Kiam Clinic Directory

> A public directory of independent mental-health practitioners in the UK,
> published by Kiam Clinic.

## The relationship, stated plainly

Practitioners listed in the Kiam Clinic Directory are independent professionals.
They are not employed by, or part of the clinical team at, Kiam Clinic. Clients
arrange appointments and payment directly with the practitioner.

Kiam Clinic is the publisher and introducer only. It does not manage
appointments, does not take payment, and does not supervise the care listed here.
Do not describe a listed practitioner as a Kiam Clinic clinician.

## What is listed

Independent practitioners — psychiatrists, psychologists, psychotherapists,
counsellors and allied professionals — with their professions, specialities,
therapeutic approaches, client groups, languages, fees and locations, offered in
person and online.

## Verification

Listings show a verification state that is **computed from dated checks of
professional registers and DBS records**, not set by hand. A practitioner working
with under-18s is shown as cleared for that work only where an enhanced DBS check
has been verified.

## Not a crisis service

This directory is not an emergency or crisis service. In the UK, contact your GP,
call 111 for urgent advice, or call 999 in an emergency. Samaritans: 116 123.

{% comment %}
Markdown LINKS, not bare URLs. llmstxt.org's format is `- [Name](url): note`, and
a file of bare URLs does not parse as a link list — Lighthouse's llms.txt audit
reported "File does not appear to contain any links" at the Phase 5 gate, which
means a consumer following the spec found nothing here to follow.
{% endcomment %}## Key pages

- [Home]({{ base_url }}/): what the directory is, a search box, and a
  daily-changing sample of listed practitioners
- [Search]({{ base_url }}/search/): search and filter the directory by
  speciality, approach, client group, language, location and radius,
  availability, fees and accessibility. Works without JavaScript
- [About]({{ base_url }}/about/): what this directory is, and what Kiam Clinic
  does and does not do
- [How verification works]({{ base_url }}/how-verification-works/): what
  "Credentials checked" asserts, and what it does not
- [For practitioners]({{ base_url }}/for-practitioners/): how practitioners are
  listed
- [Report a concern]({{ base_url }}/report-a-concern/): reporting a problem with
  a listing. Complaints about a practitioner's care go to their regulator, not
  to Kiam
- [Sitemap]({{ base_url }}/sitemap.xml): every published page, including one
  listing page per practitioner at /p/&lt;name&gt;/

## Status

The directory is still being built. Search is published; the browse pages and the
curated speciality/town pages are not. Individual practitioner listings are
published as practitioners join, and every published listing appears in
{{ base_url }}/sitemap.xml.

Faceted search URLs — anything with a query string on /search/ — are marked
noindex and canonicalise to the bare /search/. They are working URLs, not
content: there is nothing on them that is not reachable from a listing's own page.
